```{r}
library(BGLR)
library(kernlab)
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(writexl)

load("EZ.rda")
Y <- read_excel("Y_CV.xlsx")
```

# Laplacian

```{r}
SNPs <- as.matrix(read.table("gen.txt", header = TRUE, sep = ","))

IDs <- read.table("data.txt", header = TRUE) %>%
  pull(strain)

IDs <- factor(IDs, levels = rownames(SNPs))
GZ <- as.matrix(model.matrix(~ IDs - 1))

sigma_vals <- c(0,0001, 0.001, 0.01, 0.1)

GDec_list <- vector("list", length(sigma_vals))

for (i in seq_along(sigma_vals)) {
  
  sg <- sigma_vals[i]
  cat("Testing sigma =", sg, "\n")
  
  Gn <- kernelMatrix(laplacedot(sigma = sg), SNPs)
  G  <- GZ %*% Gn %*% t(GZ)
  
  GDec <- eigen(G)
  
  GDec_list[[i]] <- list(
    sigma  = sg,
    values = GDec$values,
    vectors = GDec$vectors
  )
}

names(GDec_list) <- paste0("sigma_", sigma_vals)

save(GDec_list, file = "GDec_LPC.RData")
```

```{r}
load("GDec_LPC.RData")
```

## CV1

### Yield

```{r}
yield <- Y$yield
env <- Y$environ
uenv <- unique(env)

nIter  <- 20000
burnIn <- 5000
folds  <- 1:5

set.seed(1)

lits_metrics <- list()

for (i in seq_along(GDec_list)) {
  
  GDec_i <- GDec_list[[i]]
  
  cat("Running sigma =", GDec_i$sigma, "\n")

  ETA_i <- list(
   list(X = EZ, model = "FIXED"),
   list(V = GDec_i$vectors, d = GDec_i$values, model = "RKHS")
)
  
  for (fold in folds) {
    
    cat("  Processing Fold", fold, "\n")
    
    # Test fold indices
    testing <- which(Y$CV1 == fold)
    
    # Create response with NA
    yNA <- yield
    yNA[testing] <- NA
    
    # Model fitting
    fm <- BGLR(
      y = yNA,
      ETA = ETA_i,
      nIter = nIter,
      burnIn = burnIn,
      verbose = FALSE
    )
    
    yHat <- fm$yHat
    
    for (a in uenv) {
      
      idx_env  <- which(env == a)
      conjunto <- intersect(idx_env, testing)
      
      if (length(conjunto) > 1) {
        
        cor_val <- cor(yHat[conjunto], yield[conjunto])
        
        lits_metrics[[length(lits_metrics) + 1]] <-
          data.frame(
            Sigma = GDec_i$sigma,
            Fold = fold,
            Environment = a,
            Predictive_Capacity = cor_val
          )
      }
    }
  }
}

df_metrics <- bind_rows(lits_metrics) %>% 
  group_by(Sigma, Environment) %>% 
  summarise(pred = mean(Predictive_Capacity), .groups = "drop")

write_xlsx(df_metrics, "hyper_LPC_CV1_Yield.xlsx")
```

# Polynomial

```{r}
SNPs <- as.matrix(read.table("gen.txt", header = TRUE, sep = ","))

IDs <- read.table("data.txt", header = TRUE) %>%
  pull(strain)

IDs <- factor(IDs, levels = rownames(SNPs))
GZ <- as.matrix(model.matrix(~ IDs - 1))

degree_vals <- c(2, 3)
scale_vals  <- c(0.1, 1)
offset_vals <- c(0, 1)

grid <- expand.grid(
  degree = degree_vals,
  scale  = scale_vals,
  offset = offset_vals
)

GDec_list <- vector("list", nrow(grid))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(grid))) {
  
  deg <- grid$degree[i]
  sc  <- grid$scale[i]
  off <- grid$offset[i]
  
  cat("Testing degree =", deg,
      "scale =", sc,
      "offset =", off, "\n")
  
  Gn <- kernelMatrix(
    polydot(degree = deg, scale = sc, offset = off),
    SNPs
  )
  
  G <- GZ %*% Gn %*% t(GZ)
  
  GDec <- eigen(G)
  
  GDec_list[[i]] <- list(
    degree  = deg,
    scale   = sc,
    offset  = off,
    values  = GDec$values,
    vectors = GDec$vectors
  )
}

names(GDec_list) <- apply(grid, 1, function(x) {
  paste0("d", x[1], "_s", x[2], "_o", x[3])
})

save(GDec_list, file = "GDec_POLY.RData")
```

```{r}
load("GDec_POLY.RData")
```

## CV1

### Yield

```{r}

env   <- Y$environ
uenv  <- unique(env)

nIter  <- 20000
burnIn <- 5000
folds  <- 1:5

lits_metrics <- list()

for (i in seq_along(GDec_list)) {
  
  GDec_i <- GDec_list[[i]]
  
  cat("Running: degree =", GDec_i$degree,
      "| scale =", GDec_i$scale,
      "| offset =", GDec_i$offset, "\n")
  
  ETA_i <- list(
    list(X = EZ, model = "FIXED"),
    list(V = GDec_i$vectors, d = GDec_i$values, model = "RKHS")
  )
  
  for (fold in folds) {
    
    cat("  Processing Fold", fold, "\n")
    
    testing <- which(Y$CV1 == fold)
    
    yNA <- yield
    yNA[testing] <- NA
    
    fm <- BGLR(
      y = yNA,
      ETA = ETA_i,
      nIter = nIter,
      burnIn = burnIn,
      verbose = FALSE
    )
    
    yHat <- fm$yHat
    
    for (a in uenv) {
      
      idx_env  <- which(env == a)
      conjunto <- intersect(idx_env, testing)
      
      if (length(conjunto) > 1) {
        
        cor_val <- cor(yHat[conjunto], yield[conjunto])
        
        lits_metrics[[length(lits_metrics) + 1]] <-
          data.frame(
            degree = GDec_i$degree,
            scale  = GDec_i$scale,
            offset = GDec_i$offset,
            Fold = fold,
            Environment = a,
            Predictive_Capacity = cor_val
          )
      }
    }
  }
}

df_metrics <- bind_rows(lits_metrics) %>% 
  group_by(degree, scale, offset, Environment) %>% 
  summarise(pred = mean(Predictive_Capacity), .groups = "drop")
```

# Bessel

```{r}
SNPs <- read.table("gen.txt", header = TRUE, sep = ",")

SNPs <- as.matrix(SNPs)

IDs <- read.table("data.txt", header = TRUE) %>%
  pull(strain)

IDs <- factor(IDs, levels = rownames(SNPs))
GZ <- as.matrix(model.matrix(~ IDs - 1))

sigma_vals  <- c(0.001, 0.01, 0.1)
order_vals  <- c(0, 1)
degree_vals <- c(2, 3)

grid <- expand.grid(
  degree = degree_vals,
  order  = order_vals,
  sigma  = sigma_vals
)

GDec_list <- vector("list", nrow(grid))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(grid))) {
  
  deg <- grid$degree[i]
  or  <- grid$order[i]
  sig <- grid$sigma[i]
  
  cat(" Testing: degree =", deg,
      "| order =", or,
      "| sigma =", sig, "\n")
  
  K_bsl <- kernelMatrix(
    besseldot(degree = deg, order = or, sigma = sig),
    SNPs
  )
  
  G <- GZ %*% K_bsl %*% t(GZ)
  
  GDec <- eigen(G)
  
  GDec_list[[i]] <- list(
    degree  = deg,
    order   = or,
    sigma   = sig,
    values  = GDec$values,
    vectors = GDec$vectors
  )
}

names(GDec_list) <- apply(grid, 1, function(x) {
  paste0("d", x[1], "_o", x[2], "_s", x[3])
})

save(GDec_list, file = "GDec_BSL.RData")
```

# Gaussian

```{r}
SNPs <- as.matrix(read.table("gen.txt", header = TRUE, sep = ","))

IDs <- read.table("data.txt", header = TRUE) %>%
  pull(strain)

IDs <- factor(IDs, levels = rownames(SNPs))
GZ <- as.matrix(model.matrix(~ IDs - 1))

sigma_vals <- c(0.0001, 0.001, 0.01, 0.1)

GDec_list <- vector("list", length(sigma_vals))

for (i in seq_along(sigma_vals)) {
  
  sg <- sigma_vals[i]
  cat("Testing sigma =", sg, "\n")
  
  Gn <- kernelMatrix(rbfdot(sigma = sg), SNPs)
  G  <- GZ %*% Gn %*% t(GZ)
  
  GDec <- eigen(G)
  
  GDec_list[[i]] <- list(
    sigma  = sg,
    values = GDec$values,
    vectors = GDec$vectors
  )
}

names(GDec_list) <- paste0("sigma_", sigma_vals)

save(GDec_list, file = "GDec_GAUSS.RData")
```

```{r}
load("GDec_GAUSS.RData")
```

## CV1

### Yield

```{r}
yield <- Y$yield
env <- Y$environ
uenv <- unique(env)

nIter  <- 20000
burnIn <- 5000
folds  <- 1:5

set.seed(1)

lits_metrics <- list()

for (i in seq_along(GDec_list)) {
  
  GDec_i <- GDec_list[[i]]
  
  cat("Running sigma =", GDec_i$sigma, "\n")

  ETA_i <- list(
   list(X = EZ, model = "FIXED"),
   list(V = GDec_i$vectors, d = GDec_i$values, model = "RKHS")
)
  
  for (fold in folds) {
    
    cat("  Processing Fold", fold, "\n")
    
    # Test fold indices
    testing <- which(Y$CV1 == fold)
    
    # Create response with NA
    yNA <- yield
    yNA[testing] <- NA
    
    # Model fitting
    fm <- BGLR(
      y = yNA,
      ETA = ETA_i,
      nIter = nIter,
      burnIn = burnIn,
      verbose = FALSE
    )
    
    yHat <- fm$yHat
    
    for (a in uenv) {
      
      idx_env  <- which(env == a)
      conjunto <- intersect(idx_env, testing)
      
      if (length(conjunto) > 1) {
        
        cor_val <- cor(yHat[conjunto], yield[conjunto])
        
        lits_metrics[[length(lits_metrics) + 1]] <-
          data.frame(
            Sigma = GDec_i$sigma,
            Fold = fold,
            Environment = a,
            Predictive_Capacity = cor_val
          )
      }
    }
  }
}

df_metrics <- bind_rows(lits_metrics) %>% 
  group_by(Sigma, Environment) %>% 
  summarise(pred = mean(Predictive_Capacity), .groups = "drop")

write_xlsx(df_metrics, "hyper_GAUSS_CV1_Yield.xlsx")
```
